heading: Full stack engineer building enterprise systems that scale.
roles: Full Stack Developer, Senior Software Engineer, Cloud & Microservices
bio: Five years building enterprise applications end to end — Java and Spring Boot on the backend, React and Angular on the front, deployed as microservices on AWS.
Most of my work is making existing systems faster and steadier: cutting API response times, breaking monoliths into services, and automating the release path so shipping stops being an event.
quote: I'm a lifelong learner and innovator, driven by a desire to contribute with new ideas and tools that deliver real value.
